Thanks again for taking the call last week. Per our conversation, I pulled together a short 30-minute demo focused on inference latency and cost tradeoffs for your patient-messaging use case.

Are any of these windows good on your side next week?
- Tue 8/18 10:00–10:30 PT
- Wed 8/19 14:00–14:30 PT
- Thu 8/20 11:00–11:30 PT

- 5 min: context & goals
- 15 min: live demo (real-time latency + batching settings)
- 5 min: deployment options (hosted vs dedicated vs private)
- 5 min: next steps / decision criteria

Thanks — look forward to it.

Priya —

Thanks for the options and the agenda. Unfortunately, we're in the middle of a Q4 roadmap replan and leadership redirected most of our ML effort to a data-platform migration for the next 6–10 weeks. Alyssa and I discussed and we need to deprioritize the inference/demo work for now.

Two quick notes:
- I'm traveling the week of 8/24 and will be offline for much of it.
- We still want to keep Redwood on our radar — can you keep us on a short waitlist and ping us in early November? If our roadmap loosens up we'll re-engage.

If you have any short collateral to leave behind (readiness checklist, typical SOW timeline) that would be helpful while we're re-evaluating. Appreciate the flexibility.

—Jordan
Director, Product & ML Platforms
Arcadia Health

Totally understand — thanks for the context and the heads up about travel. We'll pause active scheduling and mark the opportunity as "waitlist / deprioritized" in our tracker.

I'll send a very short readiness checklist and a one-page SOW template (no obligations) so your procurement and infra teams have visibility while you replan. If it helps, we can also record a 10-minute demo that you can share internally.

Would early-November (week of 11/2) work as a tentative ping point? If your timeline shifts earlier or later, please say the word and we'll adjust.

I'll loop Marcus for an internal follow-up on CRM cadence. Thanks again — enjoy the trip.

Best,
